name: Operator Dashboard & Digital Twin UI
purpose: The browser experience: the split-view detection hub (2D overlay + Three.js metric ground twin), the live camera page, the camera setup page, the restored-asset browser and the operator review controls. Pure client assets with no server-side import surface.

public_interfaces.name: HubCore display rules
public_interfaces.contract: Pure functions for staleness expiry, packet validity, risk/PPE presentation; unit-testable in Node without a DOM.

public_interfaces.name: telemetry packet consumption
public_interfaces.contract: Consumes the api-gateway packet contract; a stale packet must visibly expire instead of freezing the last frame.

public_interfaces.name: 3D digital twin scene
public_interfaces.contract: Renders the metric ground plane, tracks, machinery hulls and hazard geometry; a missing WebGL context degrades to a text notice, never a blank page.

acceptance_criteria: node --test tests/*.test.cjs passes with no network and no browser.
A hanging backend expires the displayed frame and metrics instead of showing stale data as live.
Hidden pages do not fetch or decode frames.
Missing WebGL still shows the camera image with an explicit notice.

build.serve: served as static assets by api-gateway at / and /setup

risks: The UI is coupled to the gateway only through the HTTP packet contract, which is not machine-checked today; a contract test would harden it.
Vendored three.js r128 is a pinned third-party asset that needs an upgrade path and a licence notice (kept in vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt).
